scope: Compile the actual live source/lift_host.c boundary and call it through public host.inner.calls. A second route executes actual lift_call/call_glue and proves EAX/EDX caller transport. Neither copies the math boundary. Unrelated lifted dispatch is isolated by a fixture; complete game callers are not claimed. Original software/hardware arithmetic executes unchanged in all16 selected modes for each single add/subtract entry. Direct host EAX/EDX/EBX/ECX and caller EAX/EDX, lazy cache writes and overflow boundary registers/cache snapshots compare. Exceptional callbacks mutate cache globals after the first call; those mutations remain live through the second call and return. Actual error callee internals are delegated, not verified here. Unmasked x87 traps, FPSW/environment and pending exceptions remain outstanding. Host marks unavailable execution with rtl_single_failures while preserving inputs/caches. Double/multiply/divide boundaries and caller flags are outside this proof.
